decisions.decision: Pattern 58 — strip trailing `=` from candidateNonce in consumeNonce before SHA-256
decisions.rationale: Play Integrity Classic API re-pads URL-safe-base64 nonces to standard-base64 length (43 → 44 chars + `=`). Without normalization, every sign-in 401s with `Nonce check: mismatch`. Empirically diagnosed via temp logs that captured both nonce values side-by-side.

decisions.decision: Per-flavor BuildConfig long for GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT_NUMBER (NOT via react-native-config dotenv)
decisions.rationale: react-native-config's dotenv.gradle emits a String BuildConfig field for every .env key in defaultConfig, which would collide with the explicit `long` per-flavor declaration (AGP merge type-mismatch). No JS caller reads Config.GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT_NUMBER. Native modules read BuildConfig directly. Documented in commit 77e981f.

decisions.decision: HIGH_SAMPLING_RATE_SENSORS in BASE manifest (universal across both flavors)
decisions.rationale: Compat probe runs identically on apkRollout + playStore. Permission is a normal-level permission (manifest-only, no runtime prompt). Required by Android 12+ when sensor sampling > 200 Hz. Mirrors Pattern 53 defense-in-depth (vitest source-grep + Gradle merged-manifest shell guard both extended).

decisions.decision: Diagnostic [COMPAT_DEBUG] + [DEBUG_REVERT_BEFORE_COMMIT] log lines must be reverted before commit
decisions.rationale: Production must NEVER log nonce material or probe error stacks at warn level. Used during debug to surface the SecurityException from the silent-catch in CompatRunningScreen + the nonce mismatch from the Play Integrity round-trip. Both fully reverted before the fix commits landed (verified via `git diff` shows clean before commit).
